Retrieve weather forecast data from the National Weather Service API

Source: R/get_nws_forecast.R
get_nws_forecast.Rd

Fetches gridpoint forecast data from the NWS API and returns a tibble for a specified weather variable.

Usage

get_nws_forecast(
  gridpoint,
  variable = c("temperature", "maxTemperature", "minTemperature", "skyCover")
)

Arguments

gridpoint

Character. NWS gridpoint in the format "office/x,y", e.g. "PDT/35,57". Find your gridpoint at https://api.weather.gov/points/{lat},{lon}.

variable

Character. The forecast variable to return. One of:

"temperature"

Hourly air temperature (°C)

"maxTemperature"

Daily maximum air temperature (°C)

"minTemperature"

Daily minimum air temperature (°C)

"skyCover"

Sky cover (percent)

Value

A tibble with columns:

datetime

POSIXct forecast valid time (UTC)

value

Numeric forecast value in native units

duration

Character ISO 8601 duration string (e.g. "PT1H")

variable

Character name of the returned variable

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
get_nws_forecast("PDT/35,57", "temperature")
get_nws_forecast("PDT/35,57", "skyCover")
} # }
